verdict.rationale: Pandoc's own GitHub repo points to a limited online demo and a WebAssembly-based online demo. That is first-party evidence that a one-off conversion can run in the browser with nothing installed. It is only a single brief mention, and the 'limited'/'demo' framing suggests constraints. Missing for 10: documentation of the browser demo's format coverage and limits, file upload/download handling, whether the WASM demo runs fully client-side/offline, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
